Under the general direction of the Director of Donor Stewardship, the Associate Director, Donor Stewardship manages the planning, coordination and execution of donor stewardship reporting and communications that demonstrate the impact of philanthropy and strengthen donor relationships.

The Associate Director oversees the production of annual digital and printed endowed fund reports, donor stewardship reports, stewardship publications and digital engagement initiatives. The position collaborates with development officers, the UC Irvine Foundation, Advancement Communications, Digital Transformation & Innovation (DTI), and campus partners to coordinate report content, financial information, beneficiary impact and stewardship communications.

The Associate Director serves as the primary project manager for stewardship reporting and communications, ensuring projects are completed accurately, on schedule and in alignment with university priorities. The position utilizes CRM reporting tools, stewardship platforms and Microsoft Excel to organize reporting data, monitor project progress and communicate business requirements to DTI to support stewardship reporting and operational efficiencies.

The Associate Director researches and recommends best practices, emerging technologies and artificial intelligence tools to enhance stewardship reporting, donor communications and program effectiveness while supporting the strategic direction established by the Director of Donor Stewardship.
This position manages the Donor Stewardship Associate.
Thorough written, verbal and interpersonal communications, tact and political acumen to effectively represent the campus.

Through knowledge and understanding of fundraising and donor stewardship concepts, principles, techniques, procedures and practices.

Thorough research, analytical and critical thinking skills, including sound judgment and decision-making skills and skill to correctly identify real and potential problems, advising management as required, and proposing effective strategic resolutions.

Knowledge of relational databases.
Ability to investigate and analyze new information and propose solutions.
